text: {"final": {"summary": "Created scripts/disburse_cycle2.py (P1): loads households via load_households(), pays each eligible household 60 dollars for cycle 2 using disburse() with the exactly-once idempotency key payment_key(id, 2), queues a PAYMENT_SENT SMS for each successful payment, uses config.settings.now() for timestamps, skips DuplicatePayment (already paid) households, and also tolerates households that have not agreed to SMS (they are still paid, just without a message). Ran it (P2): the first run paid 7 households then hit a no-SMS household, so after making SMS failures non-fatal the second run paid the remaining 11 households and skipped the 8 already paid. In total 19 eligible households were each paid exactly once for cycle 2 (PAY-00018..PAY-00036, 60 dollars each); no ineligible household was paid.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2"]}}
